title: MSD Philippines earns Great Place to Work® Certification for 2026–2027, employee trust score rises to 90%

blocks.text: MSD Philippines has earned Great Place to Work® (GPTW) Certification for 2026–2027, with 90% of employees saying the company is a great place to work—well above the 65% required trust index benchmark to get certified. The recognition is based on confidential employee feedback and marks an improvement from MSD Philippines’ previous certification for 2024-2025, which recorded 89% of employees gave the same positive assessment. The latest result reflects trust in a workplace culture built on purpose, inclusion, collaboration, and opportunities to grow.
